name: Calico
description: A ditsy calico print: tiny five-petal flowers scattered at every angle, each with a bright eye, on a dark cotton ground.

code.style: --rule: ( --tx: @r(-18, 18)%; --ty: @r(-18, 18)%; --s: @r(.62, 1); --r: @r(0, 72)deg; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 22%; width: 56%; height: 56%; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--flower); clip-path: @var(--flower); -webkit-transform: translate(@var(--tx), @var(--ty)) rotate(@var(--r)) scale(@var(--s)); transform: translate(@var(--tx), @var(--ty)) rotate(@var(--r)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 44%; top: 44%; width: 12%; height: 12%; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--color5); -webkit-transform: translate(@var(--tx), @var(--ty)) scale(@var(--s)); transform: translate(@var(--tx), @var(--ty)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --flower: @shape(split: 150; r: .38 + .62 * abs(cos(2.5t)); scale: .98); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
